paragraphs: Rav Shalman of Bei Kaluchit (or Tzaluchit).
Mentioned in Beitzah 5b, together with Rav Adda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Kaluchit and Tzaluchit are the source’s alternative place forms; their vowels and location are not independently established.

ה: gives Beitzah 5b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. The supplied אדא, Adda, differs from earlier machine ארא; no new printed check is claimed. Both Rav titles are explicit.
